channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Na Bahia, ACM Neto nega ligação com Overclean e promete controladoria estadual independente
item.description: ACM Neto (União Brasil) denied involvement in Operation Overclean and pledged, if elected governor of Bahia, to grant autonomy to the state comptroller's office, staffed by technical experts and free from political interference.

item.title: Crusoé: Os possíveis crimes de Lulinha
item.description: President Lula's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), is under investigation in three Federal Police inquiries and may face charges including influence peddling under Article 332 of the Penal Code.

item.title: Ibama testa de novo a paciência de Lula na Foz do Amazonas
item.description: Lula again showed frustration with Ibama's delay in authorizing three new Petrobras wells in Foz do Amazonas. During his visit to Amapá, the president celebrated the oil discovery, but licensing did not progress. The agency, headed by Jair Schmitt, has not yet approved the drillings despite the state-owned company meeting technical requirements.

item.title: Toffoli é sorteado para analisar pedido contra decisões de Dino no MA
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli was assigned as rapporteur for Governor Carlos Brandão's request to suspend Flávio Dino's decisions in an embezzlement investigation in Maranhão. The defense claims jurisdictional usurpation of the STJ and violation of the natural judge guarantee, noting Brandão lacked access to case files. Dino removed the governor's nephew from the TCE-MA and argues STF competence is preserved by lottery assignment, citing involvement of politicians with privileged forum.

item.title: Inelegível, Pablo Marçal apela à ‘Band’ por convite para debate presidencial
item.description: Ineligible candidate Pablo Marçal appeals to TV Band for inclusion in Sunday's presidential debate. The broadcaster is not required to invite him but often applies flexible criteria. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro indicate they will not attend.

item.title: Governo Lula cria comitê para monitorar ações a trabalhadores de app
item.description: The Lula administration established an interministerial committee to monitor policies for app-based workers such as delivery drivers and ride-hailing drivers. Coordinated by the Labor Ministry and the Presidency's Secretariat-General, the body will assess basic rights, fair pay, and produce sector diagnostics. The move follows recent credit lines as a political outreach to this workforce.

item.title: Entidades de imprensa reagem a declarações de Dino e Moraes sobre diploma para jornalistas
item.description: Press entities reacted to statements by STF ministers Flávio Dino and Alexandre de Moraes regarding a possible review of the mandatory journalism diploma requirement, which was struck down by the Supreme Court in 2009.

item.title: Candidato a deputado em SP é condenado após expor eleitora no TikTok
item.description: State deputy candidate Douglas Garcia (União Brasil) was ordered to pay R$20,000 in damages to a voter after exposing her on TikTok and Instagram without consent, having paid her R$50 to change her vote from Lula to Bolsonaro. The video garnered nearly 3 million views and triggered offensive comments. The court ordered its removal under daily fine penalty.

item.title: Equipe de Flávio Bolsonaro modula discurso contra reforma tributária e avalia abreviar transição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's team is considering shortening the tax reform transition period to cut subsidies and tax benefits, and reviewing sectors with tax relief. The plan criticizes the projected 30% VAT rate, above the OECD average.

item.title: Caiado sobre Marcola, alvo da PF: "Crime da sala do presidente"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado harshly criticizes Lula's former chief of staff Marco Aurélio (Marcola), under PF investigation for receiving jewelry and a loan from a lobbyist. Caiado claims the case reveals corruption at the highest government levels and suggests it should lead to the president's removal. He also criticizes Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's absence from a Band debate.

item.title: Reprovação de conta não significa inelegibilidade automática, diz presidente do TSE
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques stated that the rejection of accounts of a candidate who held public office does not automatically make that candidate ineligible. The statement was made on August 19, 2026.

item.title: Marqueteiro de Flávio admite desafio com eleitorado feminino
item.description: Campaign marketer Duda Lima admits Jair Bolsonaro's communication style hinders appeal to female voters, who make up 52.8% of the electorate. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign plans to deploy his wife Fernanda Bolsonaro and Daniella Marques on women-focused agendas addressing security and income, after selecting Alfredo Gaspar as running mate. Duda predicts a tight race and praises Lula's emotional connection with voters.

item.title: Quem é Pablo Marçal, candidato a presidente que deve ser barrado pela Lei da Ficha Limpa
item.description: Pablo Marçal (PRTB) launched a presidential bid despite being ineligible until 2032 following a TRE-SP conviction for improper media use in the 2024 São Paulo mayoral race. The Clean Record Law bars his candidacy without requiring a final appeal ruling, and appeals to the TSE have not yet suspended the conviction. His party registered the candidacy, but the Electoral Court must still rule on the ineligibility.

item.title: Crusoé: Marçal não afeta Lula nas redes
item.description: Pablo Marçal's candidacy announcement had little effect on mentions of Lula on social media, but drove high engagement around right-wing figures like Flávio Bolsonaro. A Datrix survey shows the most shared posts focus on Marçal and other conservative pre-candidates.

item.title: TSE registra 1,1 mil denúncias eleitorais em quatro dias
item.description: The TSE recorded 1,103 electoral complaints in four days of campaigning through the Pardal tool. Complaints refer to violations and irregularities in electoral propaganda since the campaign began on Sunday, the 16th.

item.title: Lula defende mais investimentos em defesa e que Brasil ‘possa enriquecer urânio para fins pacíficos’
item.description: Lula advocates for increased defense investment and national sovereignty, including uranium enrichment for peaceful purposes and completing the submarine program. He criticizes the discontinuity of military investments by previous governments and budget contingencies that stall strategic projects.

item.title: Lula diz que quer viver 120 anos para ver submarino nuclear pronto
item.description: President Lula (PT) visited the Aramar Nuclear Industrial Center and said he wants to live to 120 to see Brazil's nuclear-powered submarine completed. He pledged to secure funding to finish the nuclear propulsion project.

item.title: Como Donald Trump instrumentaliza a América Latina para sobreviver ao declínio imperial
item.description: Professor Jana Silverman analyzes Trump's offensive against Brazil and Latin America as an attempt to maintain declining hegemony. Trump uses trade threats and sanctions to suppress regional autonomy, particularly targeting Lula's government. Neofascism exploits resentment from workers who lost privileges under social neoliberalism.

item.title: As primeiras medidas do inquérito sobre filiação fraudulenta de Flávio ao Missão
item.description: The Federal Police opened an inquiry into the fraudulent affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to the Missão party. The PF requested access to TSE's FILIA system records and demanded clarifications from the party. The investigation, ordered by Minister Nunes Marques, will proceed at the Federal Regional Electoral Court of the Federal District.

item.title: Ex-ministro de Bolsonaro diz que PT atrasou Margem Equatorial
item.description: Former Minister Adolfo Sachsida accuses the Lula government of delaying Equatorial Margin oil exploration by four years, after Petrobras confirmed a discovery at the Morpho well off Amapá. Sachsida links the announcement to the 2026 campaign and endorses Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy to continue the project started in the previous administration.

item.title: Primeiras doações: Lula recebe R$ 500 e Grassi coloca R$ 290 mil na própria campanha
item.description: The TSE recorded the first donations for the 2026 presidential election. Lula (PT) declared R$ 500 from two individual donors, while Wilson Grassi (Democrata) self-funded R$ 290,000 across three personal contributions.

item.title: A solidão de Flávio B.
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads anti-PT preferences, statistically tied with Lula (30% vs 39% in August Quaest poll), yet faces notable isolation from other right-wing leaders.

item.title: Maior acesso a armas aumentou violência política no Brasil, aponta socióloga
item.description: A study by sociologist Angela Alonso shows that increased access to weapons has raised political violence in Brazil, with 760 killings of politicians and activists from 2003 to 2023. Most victims did not hold public office, and crimes surge during election periods.

item.title: Gilmar minimiza defesa de impeachment de ministros do STF por candidatos da direita ao Senado
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes called it a mistake the push for impeachment of STF justices by right-wing Senate candidates. He said even if elected, they would lack the conditions to advance such a process.

item.title: Após cortes na Defesa, Lula diz que vai terminar submarino nuclear
item.description: Lula visited the Aramar Nuclear Industrial Center and pledged to complete the Navy's nuclear submarine development, despite budget cuts in Defense.

item.title: Gilmar minimiza risco de impeachment de ministros com Senado de direita
item.description: Justice Gilmar Mendes (STF) stated he sees no real risk of impeachment for Supreme Court justices, even with a potential right-wing Senate majority and the possibility of Flávio Bolsonaro becoming president. He considers using impeachment as a political banner to be a mistake.

item.title: Ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula recebeu de empresária ligada a Lulinha minuta de contrato de venda de canabidiol ao Ministério da Saúde
item.description: Federal Police found messages showing Lula's former chief of staff Marcola received a draft contract for cannabidiol sales to the Health Ministry, sent by a businesswoman linked to Lulinha. The deal was not completed but reinforces investigations into influence peddling and corruption involving the president's son.

item.title: Vice de Haddad, França defende Marcola, ex-assessor de Lula: ‘Extremamente idôneo’
item.description: Márcio França, running mate for Haddad's São Paulo gubernatorial ticket, defends former Lula aide Marcola as 'extremely upright.' Marcola left the campaign after a R$249,000 deposit from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, investigated in the INSS scandal, was uncovered. França criticizes Brazil's fragile lobbying regulations.

item.title: Roscoe: “Empresários e Estado mentem para a população” sobre impostos
item.description: Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidate Flávio Roscoe (PL) claimed that businessmen and the State lie about taxes, as the tax burden is passed on to consumers. The former FIEMG president advocated for rare earth exploration and proposed streamlining environmental licensing without weakening criteria, arguing this would reduce corruption.

item.title: Investigados por fake news e tentativa de golpe seguem ativos nas eleições 2026
item.description: Agência Pública identified ten influencers investigated for disinformation and coup attempts in past elections who remain active in the 2026 campaign, including Leonardo Rodrigues de Jesus ('Leo Índio'), cousin of Flávio Bolsonaro, posting deepfakes from Argentina. A network of 31 pages with 1.4 million followers was reported to the TSE for synthetic attacks against Lula.

item.title: Demora de Flávio Bolsonaro em prestar contas do filme ‘Dark Horse' vira munição para Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) failed to deliver a promised detailed accounting of the 'Dark Horse' film financing within 30 days; after 90 days, the production company submitted court documents that do not disclose financiers like Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. The Workers' Party (PT) is leveraging the delay as electoral ammunition against the Bolsonaro family, demanding transparency over the millions received.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Real Time Big Data sobre a disputa Haddad x Tarcísio em São Paulo
item.description: A new Real Time Big Data poll on the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race will be released Monday. A previous Paraná Pesquisas poll shows incumbent Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading with 50% against 33.8% for former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT) in the first round, and 53% to 36.9% in a projected runoff.

item.title: Haddad defende “passar a régua” em investigações sobre Lulinha
item.description: Fernando Haddad defended thorough investigation of all involved in corruption cases, including Lulinha and Marcola, stating the law must apply regardless of party or family ties. The candidate praised Lula for not interfering in investigations and said it is difficult to shield government from individuals seeking illicit advantages in public service.

item.title: Lula diz que Brasil não pode andar de 'cabeça baixa' e defende enriquecimento de urânio para fins pacíficos
item.description: President Lula defended Brazilian sovereignty during a visit to the Aramar Nuclear Industrial Center, stating the country cannot walk with its "head down" before major powers. He supported investments in submarines and uranium enrichment for peaceful purposes, such as energy generation.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra por que nem todo voto de Caiado e Zema migra para Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno
item.description: Nexus poll shows Lula growing 6 points (41% to 47%) and Flávio Bolsonaro 8 points (36% to 44%) in runoff simulations. Votes from Caiado and Zema don't automatically transfer to Flávio; gender, income, and anti-Bolsonaro rejection drive some migration to Lula, particularly among evangelical women.

item.title: Por que o STF não tem pressa para decidir a sucessão no Rio
item.description: The STF again postponed judgment on Rio de Janeiro's gubernatorial succession, keeping judge Ricardo Couto as acting governor. Justices avoid deciding between direct or indirect election by the Legislative Assembly, where Speaker Douglas Ruas (PL), a gubernatorial candidate, could benefit. The court resists delegating the choice to legislators due to scandals involving Rio parliamentarians.

item.title: Orçamento terá IS e alívio à saúde para reduzir juros, diz Durigan
item.description: Minister Dario Durigan announced the 2027 Budget delivery with Selective Tax projections and health sector tax relief (zero rate for care lines, -60% on health services). He argued the measures enable interest rate cuts and criticized U.S. trade pressure, advocating dialogue without submission.

item.title: Pesquisa indica ‘efeito colateral’ da disputa Tarcísio x Haddad que pode prejudicar em Lula
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas poll indicates that Tarcísio de Freitas could win the São Paulo gubernatorial election in the first round, which would be a problem for Lula's campaign as it would leave the state without a runoff during the decisive phase of the presidential race. Fernando Haddad's goal is to keep the contest alive to support Lula's national reelection, despite historical PT rejection in São Paulo and Tarcísio's incumbent advantage.

item.title: Haddad foca em críticas a Bolsonaro em meio a "missão" dada por Lula
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's candidate for governor of São Paulo, has focused his early campaign criticisms on Jair Bolsonaro, mentioning the former president at least 14 times in a televised interview, while current governor Tarcísio de Freitas was cited 23 times. The PT's strategy aims to link Tarcísio to the Bolsonaro clan and emphasize that state government projects were funded by federal resources during the Lula and Haddad administrations, seeking to replicate the 2022 outcome when Lula narrowly lost to Bolsonaro in the state.

item.title: Fachin retira de pauta definição sobre comando do governo do RJ
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin removed from the agenda the judgment of PSD's actions regarding the interim gubernatorial election in Rio de Janeiro, scheduled for Thursday. Minister Flávio Dino had released the actions on June 30.

item.title: Vaquinhas eleitorais arrecadam mais de R$ 10 mi, e Renan arrecada quase o dobro de Bolsonaro em 2022
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão)'s electoral crowdfunding raised R$ 1.2 million in 2026, nearly double the R$ 634 million collected by Jair Bolsonaro in 2022 (inflation-adjusted). Collective financing is concentrated in Santos's campaign this election.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é “grave risco institucional”, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad labeled Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy a 'grave institutional risk' and stated he cannot conceive of Jair Bolsonaro's son reaching the presidency.

item.title: Guido Mantega: A Petrobras derruba o mito da ineficiência estatal
item.description: Guido Mantega highlights Petrobras' exceptional performance, surpassing giants like Saudi Aramco and Exxon in profitability (26% ROE in 2025) and net margin. Renewed investments and a potential discovery at the Amazon Mouth could position the state-owned company among the world's top three oil firms, debunking the myth of state inefficiency.

item.title: França diz que Marcola é uma pessoa “extremamente idônea e humilde”
item.description: Márcio França, the vice‑presidential candidate on Fernando Haddad's ticket, defended Marco Antônio Ribeiro, known as Marcola, former chief of staff to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him extremely honest and humble. França said he believes Marcola committed no wrongdoing, though he acknowledged the episode could harm Haddad's campaign as opponents might exploit it. He also argued that lobbying is a lawful activity in Brazil.

item.title: Prefeita do PT declara apoio a Cleitinho e irrita direção do partido em Minas Gerais
item.description: PT mayor Jackeliny Nascimento from Frei Gaspar, Minas Gerais, endorsed gubernatorial candidate Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicans) instead of the party's candidate Patrus Ananias. The move drew criticism from the state PT president Leninha, though no disciplinary action has been requested yet.

item.title: Haddad fala em ‘clamor’ pela reestatização da Sabesp, mas vê ‘imbróglio jurídico medonho’
item.description: Haddad acknowledges public demand for Sabesp re-statization (54-55% support) but warns of a major legal quagmire. He pledges good-faith talks to revise safeguards and tariff formulas if elected. He clarifies he's not against privatizations per se, but opposes the Sabesp model for raising prices and degrading service.

item.title: Candidatos a governador de SP assinam pacto do TRE; PSTU recusa
item.description: São Paulo gubernatorial candidates signed the TRE-SP's 'Commitment to Democracy' to combat disinformation in the 2026 elections. Tarcísio de Freitas and Márcio França supported the initiative, while PSTU's running mate Renata França refused to sign, criticizing inequalities among candidates.

item.title: Defender impeachment de ministros tem “apelo eleitoral”, diz Gilmar
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes stated that advocating impeachment of STF justices has electoral appeal but called it an 'understandable mistake' and doubted its practical implementation. He avoided projecting scenarios with a Flávio Bolsonaro victory and said impeachment promises may be mere electoral strategy. Gilmar also commented on the journalism diploma requirement, dismissing threats to press freedom.

item.title: TSE recebe mais de mil denúncias de propaganda eleitoral irregular em menos de quatro dias
item.description: The TSE received 1,103 complaints of irregular electoral propaganda via the Pardal tool in the first four days of the 2026 campaign. São Paulo leads with 193 reports, and most complaints involve paid internet boosting (339 cases). Most complaints target state deputy (424) and federal deputy (325) candidacies.

item.title: Haddad critica Tarcísio e volta a defender uso de câmeras corporais na polícia
item.description: Former Finance Minister and PT candidate for governor of São Paulo, Fernando Haddad, reiterated his support for expanding the use of body-worn cameras by police to improve public safety quality. He criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas for not advancing on this measure, stating that police transparency is essential to combat violence and increase public trust.
